exposure: No GitHub, no `gh`, no docs/audit-*.md, no docs/backlog.md and no tools/audit/round3|4|5 — none were opened; the worktree contains none. Only tests/profiles.py and tests/optimality.py were read as reusable builders. No earlier-round finding or issue body was consulted.

findings.title: The space solve refines only its four pre-scored candidates, so a cheaper reachable plan is never found
findings.claim: On the 64 heating cells of the 8x5 price x weather grid (single- and two-zone, dhw off), extending the candidate list handed to optimizer:_multi_start_minimize with 8 structured bang-bang seeds and raising _MULTI_START_SOLVES so every candidate is refined lowers the objective the solve's own captured closure scores, by a median of 0.0615 % and a maximum of 11.1729 %, with comfort-floor parity.
findings.mechanism: _multi_start_minimize scores every candidate at its RAW seed, sorts, and refines only scored[:_MULTI_START_SOLVES] (=4). A seed whose start score is poor but whose basin is cheaper is discarded before it is ever optimised, and _optimize_space_only's four structural seeds all anchor to the same total energy (or 0.35x it), so the basins between those anchors are unreachable from the refined set. Measured from the other side: appending 16 byte-copies of production's own candidates to the same seam made the shipped objective WORSE (100.0011 -> 100.4995 on two|flat|winter_cold) because the stable sort seats a duplicate beside its twin inside the top four and pushes a real basin out.

evidence.unit: % objective gap, median over 64 heating cells (max 11.1729 %)
evidence.machine: darwin arm64, 8-core Apple M1, 8 GB, shared with the other round-6 finders (load1 6.2-21.4 across the session)
evidence.contention_note: fan-out: D0 plus the other round-6 finders on the same 8-core box; counts and objective values are contention-immune. thread_factor measured 1.0000 (process_cpu 201.83 s / thread_cpu 201.83 s, BLAS pinned to 1). load1 6.2-21.4. swapins printed from vm_stat's cumulative Pageins counter, a machine-lifetime figure.
evidence.tolerance: exact (deterministic objective values; harness self-checks: production replay bitwise 80/80, null control bitwise 80/80)

perturbation.change: extend the candidate list handed to _multi_start_minimize with 8 structured seeds (bang-bang cheapest-steps-first at 0.2/0.35/0.5/0.65/0.8/1.0/1.25/1.5 x the shipped plan's own total energy, clipped to the solve's own per-step upper bounds) and raise optimizer._MULTI_START_SOLVES from 4 to the candidate count

findings.metric_definition: gap_rel = (A-B)/A per cell: A = objective value of the shipped space plan on the solve's captured objective closure; B = the value the same seam returns with the candidate list extended

null_control.command: same harness: appends 3 candidates that pre-score strictly worse than the worst already-refined one, and the inverse arm sets _MULTI_START_SOLVES=1
null_control.value: null_control_bitwise_cells=80/80 (null_control_max_abs=0.000000 %); inverse arm gap_cut1 median=-0.0018 %, max=0.0000 %
null_control.note: the flat-price arm is the price control and the residual there is named: median falls 5.0x to 0.0146 % (flat) from 0.0729 % (non-flat) and max by 36x to 0.3087 % from 11.1729 %, so the surviving flat-price gap is solver convergence, not arbitrage

reproduction_steps: check RESULT production_replay_bitwise_cells=80/80 and RESULT null_control_bitwise_cells=80/80
optional: CELLS=DEEP for the widest 16 cells
findings.proposed_fix_scope: optimizer.py only: add the structured seeds to the `starts` list in _optimize_space_only (and _solve_space) and let the refinement cover them, e.g. by ranking candidates after a cheap short refinement rather than only at the raw seed. Costs candidate evaluations, not solves, unless a new seed enters the refined set. Expect golden drift on the affected scenarios.

findings.title: Every production solve offers five candidates and refines four; the constant's comment says the list is four
findings.claim: coordinator:_warm_seeded sets _prev_shipped_plan on every production cycle, so optimizer:_multi_start_minimize is handed 5 candidates in 80 of 80 cells while _MULTI_START_SOLVES is 4, and one candidate is dropped after pre-scoring — though optimizer.py:251 states 'The candidates number four, so this is the whole list.'
findings.mechanism: #1295 added the coordinator's previous shipped plan as a fifth candidate but the comment beside _MULTI_START_SOLVES was not updated; the pre-refinement cut then discards whichever candidate scores worst at its own start.

evidence.unit: cells of 80 in which the seam is handed 5 candidates with _MULTI_START_SOLVES=4
evidence.machine: darwin arm64, 8-core Apple M1, 8 GB, shared with the other round-6 finders (load1 6.2-21.4 across the session)
evidence.contention_note: fan-out: D0 plus the other round-6 finders on the same 8-core box; counts and objective values are contention-immune. thread_factor measured 1.0000 (process_cpu 201.83 s / thread_cpu 201.83 s, BLAS pinned to 1). load1 6.2-21.4. swapins printed from vm_stat's cumulative Pageins counter, a machine-lifetime figure.

perturbation.change: set HeatPumpOptimizer._prev_shipped_plan (which coordinator:_warm_seeded sets from the previous cycle's OptimizationResult.power_schedule) from unset to the previous cycle's plan

findings.metric_definition: the number of candidates offered to _multi_start_minimize in one production solve, against optimizer._MULTI_START_SOLVES, the number refined

null_control.command: same harness, raising the cut to refine the dropped candidate and re-running the seam
null_control.note: so the drop costs nothing measurable on this grid and the defect is the stale count, not the cut

reproduction_steps: read RESULT n_cells_with_n_cand_gt_4=80 and RESULT n_cells_gap_gt_0=0
findings.proposed_fix_scope: one comment at optimizer.py:251; if the drop is also judged wrong, the cut itself, but this grid measures no plan cost from it
